subject: GovCloud SAML/SCIM/RBAC evidence request for SIG review
messages:
From: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@azuragovcloud.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: AzuraGov Compliance <compliance@azuragovcloud.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GovCloud: SAML/SCIM/RBAC evidence request for SIG review

Hi Hannah / Vanessa,

We're starting the SIG intake for our GovCloud authorization and need a set of artifacts specific to the Gov partition. Can Redwood provide the following by EOD Friday (2027-09-17):

- SAML assertion samples demonstrating Azure AD federation to Redwood in GovCloud (include full assertion with NameID, claims, and audience).
- SCIM delta logs for the last 30 days scoped to the Gov tenant (CSV preferred) showing create/modify/delete events, timestamps, and actor IDs.
- RBAC owner matrix tying roles to owners and justification for least-privilege decisions (service accounts included).
- Short narrative on how we isolate Gov keys/metadata (KMS/HSM boundaries) and any redaction steps for PII in logs.

Also let us know if any artifacts require a formal NDA or different handling before delivery. If you're unable to include live assertions from Gov infra, a representative sample with headers and hashes will suffice — we just need to validate claim mapping and audience restriction.

Thanks,
Marta
Marta Gomez
Senior Cloud Security Engineer
AzuraGov

(Attachment: SIG intake form referenced in separate link)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Gomez <marta.gomez@azuragovcloud.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GovCloud: SAML/SCIM/RBAC evidence request for SIG review

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes and proposed plan: 

- Owners: I'll lead collection for SAML + narrative. Vanessa will coordinate SCIM exports with infra and Jonas will produce the RBAC owner matrix.
- Timeline: aiming to deliver sample SAML assertions + RBAC matrix by Thu 2027-09-16 EOD, and SCIM delta CSV by Fri 2027-09-17 EOD as requested. If infra needs extra time for Gov exports, we'll flag immediately.
- Gov separation: there is a known extra step to activate Gov KMS key-material exports; if you require key materials we may need a signed LOA — otherwise we can provide redacted proofs and KMS key IDs.

Action items for us:
1) Produce SAML assertion PDF (hannah)
2) Export SCIM delta (vanessa + infra)
3) Generate RBAC owner matrix + least-priv justification (jonas)

I'll circle back with a delivery email that includes the files and a short README that maps fields to SIG questions. If you have a preferred CSV schema for SCIM delta, send it over and we'll match it.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

--

Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 12:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GovCloud: SAML/SCIM/RBAC evidence request for SIG review

Thanks Hannah — a couple clarifications to help us validate quickly:

- SCIM CSV schema: please include columns [event_id, timestamp_utc, op_type, resource_type, resource_id, actor_id, raw_payload_hash]. We use the hash to confirm content without needing full payload.
- SAML assertions: please ensure the sample includes recipient/audience and ConfirmationMethod elements. If you can remove any long-lived tokens from the sample while keeping the assertion structure intact that would be ideal.
- RBAC matrix: include a column for "justification" (short text) and a column indicating whether that role is allowed for Gov tenants only.

One ask on redaction: we need to confirm whether SCIM logs include user-typed PII fields (mailing address, SSN-like fields). If so, annotate which columns have been redacted and the redaction method.

Lastly, we've started a SIG intake in our portal (ID: SIG-2027-1129). If Redwood prefers to upload artifacts via your secure transfer, send a separate transfer token and we'll attach to the portal.

Cheers,
Marta

Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 14:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: GovCloud: SAML/SCIM/RBAC evidence request for SIG review

Marta — thanks for the schema and SIG ID. Quick update and what you'll see in the delivery package: 

- Delivery plan: we'll upload a ZIP to the secure transfer you provide and also drop a copy into the Drive link (see related_links). Files included: saml-assertion-samples-govcloud.pdf (redacted token values, includes audience & confirmation sections), scim-delta-snapshot-20270901.csv (includes raw_payload_hash column and redaction notes), rbac-owner-matrix.csv (role, owner, justification, gov-only flag), govcloud-evidence-workback-plan.xlsx (timeline + owners + known blockers).
- Redaction: SCIM payloads are redacted by column with SHA256 hashes retained for verification. We'll include a README that maps redaction steps to SIG questions. No plaintext PII will be in the CSV export.
- KMS / key-material: we can provide KMS key IDs and a signed statement of separation; raw key material will not be shared without LOA.

Next steps: please send the secure transfer token/URL for upload (or confirm SIG portal upload is preferred). Expect the ZIP by Thu 2027-09-16 18:00 PST for the SAML+RBAC items and Fri 2027-09-17 18:00 PST for SCIM with hashes.

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments (to be uploaded): saml-assertion-samples-govcloud.pdf, scim-delta-snapshot-20270901.csv, rbac-owner-matrix.csv, govcloud-evidence-workback-plan.xlsx
